summary: Frontend-only e2e UI testing of Gardim informational website at https://gardim-cafe.preview.emergentagent.com on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All requested data-testid hooks present. Hero, Navbar, Signature, Menu (sidebar + scrolling), About, Gallery, Footer, mobile drawer all render and behave correctly. Backend skipped per request.

issues: Embedded Google Map iframe uses very strong CSS filter (invert + hue-rotate + saturate + grayscale) for dark theme — readability of street labels is significantly reduced. Visually consistent with theme but borderline accessibility.
The Emergent platform 'Made with Emergent' badge sits at bottom-right and may visually overlap the footer WhatsApp button on small viewports. This is platform UI, not app code, but worth noting.

action_items: Minor: request mentions '15 categories' but data/menu.js + UI both expose 14 categories (matching the comma-separated list of 14 names actually given in the request). If 15 was intended, add the missing one; otherwise update the count text in the spec/PRD.
Optional: tone down the map iframe CSS filter for better legibility, or provide a 'view in Google Maps' fallback (already partly covered by 'Cómo llegar' link).
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar nav link 'historia' scrolls to id='historia' which does not exist as a dedicated section; it currently lands inside the About component because About contains an inner anchor. Verified element exists, but consider adding id='historia' to the About <section> explicitly so 'Historia' nav is semantically correct (currently relies on a child element).

Footer uses a Google Maps embed via maps.google.com/maps?...&output=embed (no API key). This works without a key but is technically an unsupported/legacy embed; consider an official Embed API key in env for production reliability.
Hero animation uses inline <style> for keyframes. Acceptable, but better placed in App.css to centralize animations.
All components correctly use data-testid attributes (good test coverage hooks).
test_credentials: N/A — public informational site, no auth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids verified. Verified flows: hero title 'Gardim', explore button text 'Descubrir la Carta', explore button scrolls to #firma (scrollY ~1090), nav-whatsapp href contains wa.me/5491150179702 with prefilled text, all 4 signature items render (copa-gardim, cafe-gardim, don-pedro, affogato), 14/14 menu categories present with sidebar buttons, sidebar click scrolls to #cat-{id}, item-helados-0 shows 'Una Bocha' + '$ 2.800', item-copas-heladas-0 shows 'Copa Gardim' + '$ 11.500', About has 30/100/365 stats, Gallery shows 6 images and instagram-cta, Footer has whatsapp/instagram/map-link/map. Mobile drawer toggles open/close (height 1->393->1). No broken Unsplash images. Console: no errors.
rca of the issue: No bugs requiring RCA — all listed acceptance criteria pass.
